lines.x: Doctor, are you ready to work? I won't take no for an answer. C'mon. 3, 2, 1, start.
Nails are part of a girl's appeal. Gotta take good care of them.

Why do I call myself Utage? Well, it's not that complicated. It means 'Party' in Higashinese, and I just wanna live my life like it's a party every night. If I'm in a good mood, everything else is gonna be okay.
You already saw it, Doctor? Well, that's too bad. Now the only way out is for you… is to come with me and use this two-for-one coupon.

When I got Oripathy and started talking about coming here, my mom was worried about bullying. So she gave me the family heirloom, Shishiou, to defend myself. Didn't find any bullies, but I did manage to cut up some pretty bad guys. Doctor, you really know how to treat a girl.
The people here turn all scary when they get serious. I'm as scary as six of them put together? Really…? Am I that terrifying?

Doc. Help me pick up ten boxes of limited-edition cookie sticks tomorrow? Just give me an advance on my pay. What? I've advanced the whole thing already? Aww c'mon, there's gotta be something you can do. Please, Doctor!
Doctor, you're razor-sharp some of the time and dull as a block at others. I don't get why. Oh, I see, right out of that 'How to Talk to Girls' book, huh? I'd expect nothing less from you, Doctor.
It's not good to rely too much on any one person, but maybe the Doctor is an... Eek, Doctor! Oh it's nothing, I was just rambling to myself! D-D-Did you need something from me?
If you're tired, just go to bed. Not that complicated.
Hey, Doctor. I'm your new operator, Utage. My hobbies are... Oh, I don't need to go into the details? Alright then, I look forward to working with you.
Is it over?
Do I get work less after I get promoted? No dice? Oh well…
I guess it's time for me to get serious. Alright, let's crush the bad guys!
Alright, everyone, I'll be counting on your orders!
Hmm, team captain… Eh? Me? Captain?
Time to go.
C'mon, c'mon! I can't wait any longer.
Yeees?
Need me?
Moving out!
Hehe.
Who should I cut?
It won't hurt if I don't miss.
I'll take what you don't need.
You look kinda cute when you cry.
Ahh, it felt good to blow off all that steam. Exciting stuff. Let's go for crepes, Doctor.
That was so much fun. Thanks for all the enemies!
You're saving the stragglers for me? Well, I'll dig right in.
C'mon, Doctor, stop spacing out and start running.
As long as I can get my magazines, it doesn't really matter where I stay.
Oh?
Wanna go sing karaoke?
Arknights.
Oh, hey, Doctor. Happy New Year! As you can see, I'm trapped under this kotatsu... Hang with me for a bit maybe? It's waaarm. C'mon, just try it, you won't regret it!
Morning, Doctor.

Doctor, happy birthday. Did you know? There's a real trick to birthday parties. I could share some hacks with you, like, on the down-low, to really up your popularity at dinnertime. Number one—wait, are these all your presents?! This whole room?!

The dinner party today was, like, killer. That's the kind of thing you should really do every day. Otherwise, you start overthinking things and get all hung up on it. Then stuff gets worse and lose all your optimism for life, which is tough to hold onto. Meh, that's just me babbling to myself, don't worry about it. Anyway, enjoy the happiness you've got in the moment, that's what matters most!
